metadata.material: Bulk diamond silicon (Si), space group Fd-3m (227)
metadata.calculation: VASP HSE06 hybrid-functional electronic band structure
metadata.native_reference_note: NIST material page states energies shifted to E_F=0; official jarvis/db/vasp_to_xml.py ebandstruct subtracts vrun.efermi.
metadata.kpoints_caveat: Original HSE XML stores only sample indices and high-symmetry labels. Inferred fractional reciprocal coordinates copied from same material official optB88-vdW band KPOINTS: all 12 label indices and the 164-point length exactly match the HSE path after its first 29 points. HSE original KPOINTS was not supplied by XML download links.
metadata.kpoints_coordinate_system: Fractional coordinates in reciprocal primitive-lattice basis, inferred mapping as above. No actual Cartesian HSE k coordinates claimed.
metadata.spins: Spin-up data retained. Lowest eight path bands coincide within numerical precision (see difference); high unoccupied bands show larger convergence differences.
metadata.CBM_note: Sampled minimum, no extremum fitting or band-gap correction applied.
metadata.lattice_parameter_caveat: Material page describes optB88-vdW relaxed structure; HSE-specific relaxation not independently documented in downloaded XML.
metadata.license_note: NIST information is public information and may be distributed/copied unless marked copyrighted; appropriate source credit requested. No separate copyright mark was found on this material record.
